856-2438-5776-8347.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

4446-5170-6132-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
4446-5170-6132-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

4279-4314-4699--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-4314-4699--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental, Pawn of Ulamog and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog ability, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4875-5414-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4875-5414-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability, preventing the next 2 damage dealt to a target this turn.
Repeat from step 3.

1339-6720-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1339-6720-8192.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 1 life to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

4694-5686-6258-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
You control a permanent that is boosting the toughness of all your creatures by at least 1, or that is giving a creature a +1/+1 counter as it enters the battlefield.

4694-5686-6258-7306.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 1.
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing another creature, creating a Blood token.
The Blood token enters the battlefield as a 0/0 creature due to March of the Machines, and will have its toughness boosted by the permanent specified in the pre-requisites to prevent it from dying.
Repeat.

Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

Resolve the Longshot trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Displacer KItten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.

Activate Evereth by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
1170-5131-6495-7356--202.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.

Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

Activate Earthcraft by tapping Spore Frog, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

Repeat.

Repeat each combat phase.

When the token Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Great Oak Guardian trigger, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.

Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.

Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.

Activate Lady Sun by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
914-1115-3335.notes: If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

Resolve the copy of Mystical Tutor, causing you to search your library for Nexus of Fate and put it on top of your library.
Move to your extra turn, causing you to draw Nexus of Fate during your draw step.
Repeat.
